title: stare.pub self-hosted copy description, format 1
description: <root>/mirror/mirror.json in a self-hosted copy of stare.pub (#231), served at /mirror/mirror.json: which mirror release the copy holds, the date of its data, and its components. The reader reads it on any host that isn't stare.pub's and, when it is a `stare-mirror` file at a 1.x format_version, reads the copy's /mirror/idx and /mirror/data instead of idx.stare.pub and data.stare.pub. stare.pub's release process writes it into the tier 1 tar; mirror-kit/README.md shows it for anyone writing it by hand. A reader accepts any 1.x file and ignores fields it doesn't know; a change that would make a 1.0 reader misread a file is a new major version.

format_version.description: SemVer of this format. 1.0.0 is the first.

upstream.description: The site this is a copy of. The reader links only to stare.pub whatever this says.

release.description: The mirror release the copy holds (CalVer), as named under data.stare.pub/releases/.

data_date.description: The date of the copy's newest data, shown in the reader's banner ("data from 2026-11-08") and on a /k/ key the copy's ledger doesn't have.

tiers.description: The tiers the copy holds in full: 1 lookup, 2 text and search, 3 pages, 4 the CAP archive. Informational; the reader decides what to offer from `components`.

components.description: Each component present, by id, with its version. Tier 1: `site`, `index`, `crk`, `pdf-manifest`, `kit`. Ids that turn on a reader feature: `cap` or `cl` (case text, tier 2), `search` (the full-text search tree, tier 2), any id starting `pdf/` (archival page PDFs, tier 3), any starting `cap-raw/` (CAP's raw scans, tier 4). A feature whose component is absent is said in place with a link to the same page on stare.pub.

version.description: The component's own version (CalVer for data and the site).
